title: SweetCandy! drops the ultimate girls night track with "ON REPEAT"
htmlContent: If you’ve been in need of a soundtrack that embodies the joys of just having fun with your girls, SweetCandy! has just given your playlist that with her most recent single, “ON REPEAT” featuring Laf0822. SweetCandy! transforms that energy into something magnetic. From the moment the beat comes in, “ON REPEAT” takes your hand, kicks off your work shoes, and hurtles right into party mode. Clocking out after a long day, or finally taking your well-deserved night out, this one gives you permission to chase the stress away and soak up the fun. There’s a beating heart under all the sparkle here. You can sense the muscle memory packed into every bounce and rhythm-hugging vocal line, the come-ups where laughter rings louder than the bass. SweetCandy! wants you to remember what it feels like to be you, in an unfiltered state, surrounded by love, light, and glitter. With tight production and infectious energy, the EP strikes the right balance between slick pop polish and that inimitable freedom of girls just wanting to have fun. https://open.spotify.com/track/1tQzbF1QAmYOnWFjngaSsV It’s got that feel of a song you accidentally play 12 times in a row and still scream “this is my jam!” every single time. Not so much a track as a vibe. A celebration. With “ON REPEAT,” SweetCandy! is serving a song. So she’s bottling that sisterly spirit and self-expression, shaking it up with a splash of sass, and handing it to you like a great, big, pink cocktail in the golden hour.
